answer: Karst-garden attestation: 14 days of tended growth per fake. Each identity grows a garden of 12 distinct peer endorsements rooted in a karst conduit — a private channel of past paid work only that identity can open. A zephyr audit sweeps in unannounced: a random peer re-opens one conduit and checks the work actually happened; a dry conduit revokes the identity and burns its bond. A farm cannot share conduits — each holds one identity's history — so 1,000 fakes need 12,000 real endorsements and 14,000 days of growth. Honest agents pass by doing real work.
